# Kafka broker under-replicated partitions after disk failure

Producers see errors and the cluster reports partitions without full replication.

A disk failed on broker 3 taking its log directory offline; partitions led by that broker fell below min.insync.replicas so producers with acks=all were rejected.

1. Confirm the offline log dir and under-replicated partitions
2. Replace the failed disk / move the log dir to a healthy volume
3. Reassign partitions and let replicas catch up to ISR
4. Verify UnderReplicatedPartitions returns to zero

Error Details
```
UnderReplicatedPartitions = 27; NotEnoughReplicasException; producer error 'NOT_ENOUGH_REPLICAS' (code 19); broker 3 log dir offline
```

Tags: messaging, kafka, under-replicated, not-enough-replicas, disk-failure
